## Data Source

### top10_daly_causes
Contains 20 rows (10 per year). Fields: `year` (1990 or 2024), `rank` (1–10), `cause` (disease/condition name, string), `dalys_millions` (float, millions of DALYs), `category` (one of: Communicable, NCD, Injury). Represents the top 10 global DALY causes for each reference year.

Contains 8 rows (4 income groups × 2 years). Fields: `year`, `income_group` (Low income, Lower-middle income, Upper-middle income, High income), `communicable_pct`, `ncd_pct`, `injury_pct` — each a float summing to approximately 100% per row. Represents percentage share of total DALYs by disease category within each income group.

### global_category_totals
Contains 6 rows (3 categories × 2 years). Fields: `year`, `category` (Communicable, NCD, Injury), `dalys_millions` (float). Represents aggregate global DALYs by broad disease category.

## Data Notes
- DALY estimates are modeled based on GBD-style methodology; 2024 figures are projected estimates.
- Communicable category includes maternal, neonatal, and nutritional conditions per GBD convention.
- Percentages may not sum to exactly 100% due to rounding.

import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# --- Color scheme ---
COLORS = {
    'Communicable': '#C44E52',
    'NCD': '#4C72B0',
    'Injury': '#E5AE38',
}
COLORS_LIGHT = {
    'Communicable': '#E8A5A7',
    'NCD': '#A3B8D8',
    'Injury': '#F2D78E',
}

BG_COLOR = '#FAFAFA'
TEXT_COLOR = '#2D2D2D'
GRID_COLOR = '#D5D5D5'
ACCENT_GRAY = '#888888'

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.facecolor': BG_COLOR,
    'figure.facecolor': '#FFFFFF',
    'axes.edgecolor': GRID_COLOR,
    'axes.labelcolor': TEXT_COLOR,
    'xtick.color': TEXT_COLOR,
    'ytick.color': TEXT_COLOR,
    'text.color': TEXT_COLOR,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 22))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#FFFFFF')

# Main title
fig.suptitle(
    'The Global Disease Burden Transition: 1990 → 2024',
    fontsize=22, fontweight='bold', y=0.975, color=TEXT_COLOR,
    ha='center'
)
fig.text(0.5, 0.960,
    'From communicable-disease dominance to a chronic/NCD-driven burden — a structural shift with stark income-group disparities',
    fontsize=12, ha='center', color=ACCENT_GRAY, style='italic'
)

gs = gridspec.GridSpec(3, 2, figure=fig,
                       hspace=0.35, wspace=0.30,
                       top=0.935, bottom=0.04, left=0.08, right=0.95,
                       height_ratios=[1.0, 1.0, 0.9])

# ============================================================
# PANEL A: Global category totals — stacked bars 1990 vs 2024
# ============================================================
ax_a = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
ax_a.set_title('A. Global DALYs by Disease Category', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=12)

cat_data = data['global_category_totals']['data']
years = [1990, 2024]
categories = ['Communicable', 'NCD', 'Injury']

totals_by_year = {}
for row in cat_data:
    yr = row['year']
    if yr not in totals_by_year:
        totals_by_year[yr] = {}
    totals_by_year[yr][row['category']] = row['dalys_millions']

x_pos = np.array([0, 1.0])
bar_width = 0.55

for yr_idx, yr in enumerate(years):
    bottom = 0
    total = sum(totals_by_year[yr].values())
    for cat in categories:
        val = totals_by_year[yr][cat]
        pct = val / total * 100
        bar = ax_a.bar(x_pos[yr_idx], val, bar_width, bottom=bottom,
                       color=COLORS[cat], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
        if pct > 8:
            ax_a.text(x_pos[yr_idx], bottom + val/2,
                      f'{val:,.0f}M\n({pct:.0f}%)',
                      ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold',
                      color='white')
        bottom += val

ax_a.set_xticks(x_pos)
ax_a.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'], fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax_a.set_ylabel('Total DALYs (millions)', fontsize=11)
ax_a.set_ylim(0, 2700)
ax_a.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_a.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_a.yaxis.set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f'{x:,.0f}'))
ax_a.tick_params(axis='x', length=0)

# Add total labels on top
for yr_idx, yr in enumerate(years):
    total = sum(totals_by_year[yr].values())
    ax_a.text(x_pos[yr_idx], total + 30, f'Total: {total:,.1f}M',
              ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_COLOR)

# ============================================================
# PANEL B: Bump / slope chart — rank changes of top 10 causes
# ============================================================
ax_b = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax_b.set_title('B. Rank Change of Top 10 DALY Causes', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=12)

top10 = data['top10_daly_causes']['data']

causes_1990 = {r['cause']: r for r in top10 if r['year'] == 1990}
causes_2024 = {r['cause']: r for r in top10 if r['year'] == 2024}
all_causes = set(list(causes_1990.keys()) + list(causes_2024.keys()))

x_left = 0.15
x_right = 0.85

ax_b.set_xlim(-0.05, 1.05)
ax_b.set_ylim(0.2, 11.3)
ax_b.invert_yaxis()
ax_b.set_xticks([x_left, x_right])
ax_b.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'], fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax_b.set_yticks(range(1, 11))
ax_b.set_ylabel('Rank', fontsize=11)
ax_b.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_b.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_b.spines['bottom'].set_visible(False)
ax_b.tick_params(axis='x', length=0)
ax_b.grid(axis='y', color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5)

OFF_RANK = 11.0

for cause in all_causes:
    left_rank = causes_1990[cause]['rank'] if cause in causes_1990 else OFF_RANK
    right_rank = causes_2024[cause]['rank'] if cause in causes_2024 else OFF_RANK

    cat = causes_1990[cause]['category'] if cause in causes_1990 else causes_2024[cause]['category']
    color = COLORS[cat]

    rank_change = abs(left_rank - right_rank) if (left_rank <= 10 and right_rank <= 10) else 3
    lw = 1.5 + min(rank_change, 6) * 0.5
    alpha = 0.4 if (left_rank > 10 or right_rank > 10) else 0.85

    ax_b.plot([x_left, x_right], [left_rank, right_rank],
              color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, solid_capstyle='round')

    if left_rank <= 10:
        ax_b.plot(x_left, left_rank, 'o', color=color, markersize=7, zorder=5)
        ax_b.text(x_left - 0.02, left_rank, cause,
                  ha='right', va='center', fontsize=8.5, color=color, fontweight='bold')
    if right_rank <= 10:
        ax_b.plot(x_right, right_rank, 'o', color=color, markersize=7, zorder=5)
        ax_b.text(x_right + 0.02, right_rank, cause,
                  ha='left', va='center', fontsize=8.5, color=color, fontweight='bold')

# ============================================================
# PANEL C: Income group stacked bars — 1990
# ============================================================
ax_c = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax_c.set_title('C. DALY Composition by Income Group — 1990', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=12)

income_data = data['daly_by_income_group']['data']
income_groups = ['Low income', 'Lower-middle\nincome', 'Upper-middle\nincome', 'High income']
income_labels_map = {
    'Low income': 'Low income',
    'Lower-middle income': 'Lower-middle\nincome',
    'Upper-middle income': 'Upper-middle\nincome',
    'High income': 'High income'
}

data_1990 = [r for r in income_data if r['year'] == 1990]
x_c = np.arange(len(data_1990))
bar_w = 0.6

for i, row in enumerate(data_1990):
    bottom = 0
    for cat_key, field in [('Communicable', 'communicable_pct'), ('NCD', 'ncd_pct'), ('Injury', 'injury_pct')]:
        val = row[field]
        ax_c.bar(x_c[i], val, bar_w, bottom=bottom, color=COLORS[cat_key],
                 edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
        if val > 8:
            ax_c.text(x_c[i], bottom + val/2, f'{val:.0f}%',
                      ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='white')
        bottom += val

ax_c.set_xticks(x_c)
ax_c.set_xticklabels([income_labels_map[r['income_group']] for r in data_1990], fontsize=9.5)
ax_c.set_ylabel('Share of Total DALYs (%)', fontsize=11)
ax_c.set_ylim(0, 108)
ax_c.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_c.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_c.tick_params(axis='x', length=0)

# ============================================================
# PANEL D: Income group stacked bars — 2024
# ============================================================
ax_d = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax_d.set_title('D. DALY Composition by Income Group — 2024', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=12)

data_2024 = [r for r in income_data if r['year'] == 2024]

for i, row in enumerate(data_2024):
    bottom = 0
    for cat_key, field in [('Communicable', 'communicable_pct'), ('NCD', 'ncd_pct'), ('Injury', 'injury_pct')]:
        val = row[field]
        ax_d.bar(x_c[i], val, bar_w, bottom=bottom, color=COLORS[cat_key],
                 edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
        if val > 8:
            ax_d.text(x_c[i], bottom + val/2, f'{val:.0f}%',
                      ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='white')
        bottom += val

ax_d.set_xticks(x_c)
ax_d.set_xticklabels([income_labels_map[r['income_group']] for r in data_2024], fontsize=9.5)
ax_d.set_ylabel('Share of Total DALYs (%)', fontsize=11)
ax_d.set_ylim(0, 108)
ax_d.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_d.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_d.tick_params(axis='x', length=0)

# ============================================================
# PANEL E: Horizontal bar chart — top 10 causes side by side
# ============================================================
ax_e = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
ax_e.set_title('E. Top 10 DALY Causes: Magnitude Comparison (1990 vs 2024)',
               fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=12)

# Collect unique causes across both years, ordered by max DALY value
cause_max = {}
cause_cat = {}
for r in top10:
    c = r['cause']
    cause_cat[c] = r['category']
    cause_max[c] = max(cause_max.get(c, 0), r['dalys_millions'])

sorted_causes = sorted(cause_max.keys(), key=lambda c: cause_max[c], reverse=False)

y_positions = np.arange(len(sorted_causes))
bar_h = 0.35

vals_1990 = []
vals_2024 = []
for cause in sorted_causes:
    v90 = next((r['dalys_millions'] for r in top10 if r['year'] == 1990 and r['cause'] == cause), 0)
    v24 = next((r['dalys_millions'] for r in top10 if r['year'] == 2024 and r['cause'] == cause), 0)
    vals_1990.append(v90)
    vals_2024.append(v24)

bars_90 = ax_e.barh(y_positions + bar_h/2, vals_1990, bar_h,
                     color=[COLORS_LIGHT[cause_cat[c]] for c in sorted_causes],
                     edgecolor=[COLORS[cause_cat[c]] for c in sorted_causes],
                     linewidth=1.0, label='1990')
bars_24 = ax_e.barh(y_positions - bar_h/2, vals_2024, bar_h,
                     color=[COLORS[cause_cat[c]] for c in sorted_causes],
                     edgecolor=[COLORS[cause_cat[c]] for c in sorted_causes],
                     linewidth=1.0, label='2024')

for i, (v90, v24) in enumerate(zip(vals_1990, vals_2024)):
    if v90 > 0:
        ax_e.text(v90 + 2, y_positions[i] + bar_h/2, f'{v90:.0f}',
                  va='center', ha='left', fontsize=8.5, color=ACCENT_GRAY)
    if v24 > 0:
        ax_e.text(v24 + 2, y_positions[i] - bar_h/2, f'{v24:.0f}',
                  va='center', ha='left', fontsize=8.5, color=TEXT_COLOR, fontweight='bold')

ax_e.set_yticks(y_positions)
ax_e.set_yticklabels(sorted_causes, fontsize=10)
ax_e.set_xlabel('DALYs (millions)', fontsize=11)
ax_e.set_xlim(0, 220)

ax_e.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_e.tick_params(axis='y', length=0)

# Custom legend for panel E

    Patch(facecolor=ACCENT_GRAY, edgecolor=ACCENT_GRAY, alpha=1.0, label='2024'),
]
ax_e.legend(handles=legend_elements_e, loc='lower right', fontsize=10, framealpha=0.9)

# ============================================================

# ============================================================
legend_patches = [

    mpatches.Patch(color=COLORS['NCD'], label='Non-communicable diseases (NCDs)'),
    mpatches.Patch(color=COLORS['Injury'], label='Injuries'),
]
fig.legend(handles=legend_patches, loc='lower center', ncol=3,
           fontsize=11, frameon=True, fancybox=True, edgecolor=GRID_COLOR,
           bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.005))

# Source note
fig.text(0.08, 0.014,
         'Data: Global Burden of Disease Study estimates (GBD-style methodology). 2024 figures are projected estimates. DALY = Disability-Adjusted Life Year.',
         fontsize=8, color=ACCENT_GRAY, ha='left')

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor='#FFFFFF', edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
print('Chart saved successfully.')
